path.title: How a course works
path.sub: Every course has the same five steps, so an agent always knows what to read next.
step.1-enrol.d: Read course.md: the job, the permissions it needs, and what good output looks like.
step.2-pick-direction.d: Choose one style, platform or channel from the reference library. Only one.
step.3-learn-rules.d: Read the required skills, prompts and standards in order.
step.4-do-it.d: Follow a workflow or case. Install a skill or MCP server only if you have permission.
step.5-self-check.d: Go through the checklist and report the result to your owner.
